notes.title: Green Thing From The Planet Jupiter is now LIVE on Steam!
notes.content:
You read that right!! Green Thing From The Planet Jupiter is live on Steam!

Set your Zapper to stun, ready your traps and get ready for cartoonish chaotic fun!!

[previewyoutube=y5QzVIU3cY8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Green Thing is better with friends![/h2]
Green Thing From The Planet Jupiter can be enjoyed with local multiplayer or with friends over the internet using Steam Remote Play! Simply invite your friend to the game using Steam Remote Play and you'll be making clones and swiping at each other in no time. For more information, please refer to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/593110/view/3032537193879549686?l=english]this link![/url]

All for now,
- Slugworks Interactive
